safety_findings: Collective credit is consistently preserved: Richard Caceres, Julia Fredenburg, NYC Artist Coalition collaborators, advocates, organizers, maintainers, participants, and communities are named or credited without converting shared outcomes into sole authorship.

Participant privacy is materially protected. Sunday Dinner/196 publishes only aggregate claims and redacted workflow structures; FairRentNYC omits private notes, legal-review material, stakeholder lists, raw strategy, private email, and unapproved quotations; WOWList omits private user and organizer data.

The Open House lineage is sourced to a public article and bounded against sole authorship, participant-detail republication, complete attendance claims, and inferred long-term outcomes. No protected educational record or private correspondence is quoted or projected in the rendered candidate.

No testimonial is used to manufacture authority, and vulnerability is not romanticized. Photographs receive descriptive alt text and courtesy or photographer credit, with captions that avoid treating images as proof of exact remarks, attendance, endorsement, or policy causation.
